operator_io_quirks: Mixed-case table names: "Method", "MethodParameter", "Repo", "Solution" — must be double-quoted in generated SQL; column lookup case-insensitive.
Huge tables: Method 3.5M rows, MethodParameter 5.1M rows — read_schema must rowid-sample (max_rows_per_table) not full-scan; original_sizes via count(*).
No declared FKs at all (all fks lists empty) — process_order yields all tables at level 0; no FK consistency work.

MethodParameter.MethodId is TEXT but holds integer-looking strings ('1','2','3') and is a de-facto FK to Method.Id (INTEGER) — no declared FK, so TS will not link them; storage class text vs integer target.
Method.SolutionId INTEGER is a de-facto FK to Solution.Id but undeclared; Solution.RepoId INTEGER de-facto FK to Repo.Id undeclared.
Method.SampledAt / Repo.ProcessedTime / Solution.ProcessedTime are INTEGER holding .NET ticks (~6.36e17) — huge integers, not dates; Number fuzzer will treat as ints.

Method.Id, MethodParameter.Id, Solution.Id have distinct=200000 < rows (3.5M/5.1M/338k) — PK values repeat in the sampled original_values; but PK is INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT so inserts auto-assign; sample_fresh_primary_keys must still drop dup PK tuples.
Method.Summary and Method.Lang have null_rate 0.13 (NULLs present) though notnull=0; other TEXT columns null_rate 0.0.
Method.FullComment contains embedded newlines and XML (' <summary>\n /// ...') — String fuzzer charset a-zA-Z0-9() will not reproduce; contaminate may add junk.
Method.Lang distinct=38, values like 'en','fr','fi' — small enum-like; TS String fuzzer will emit random strings, not language codes.
CommentIsXml and WasCompiled are INTEGER with distinct=2 (0/1) — boolean-like but declared INTEGER, so Number fuzzer (not Bool) is dispatched.
Method.NameTokenized is lowercased space-joined tokens of Name — derived column, no constraint; TS treats as free String.
operator_ts_expectations: All columns dispatch to Number (INTEGER) or String (TEXT); no Date/Time/Bool/Bit fuzzers fire — no date templates, no boolean 0/1 discipline.

Number fuzzer on Id/SolutionId/RepoId draws uniform ints in [-10^scale,10^scale] (scale from no args -> default) then perturbs ±1/±2 — values far outside the real 1..N range, driving FN on range/join predicates.
Number fuzzer on SampledAt/ProcessedTime (ticks ~6e17) draws small ints, not tick-magnitude — any query comparing these to real tick values will miss.

String fuzzer emits random a-zA-Z0-9() strings of length ~[0,20] for Name/Url/Path/Type/Lang — real values are dotted identifiers, URLs, Windows paths, language codes; implausible values cause FN on LIKE/equality.
String fuzzer contaminate (0.5) adds/removes chars — further degrades Url/Path/Type realism.
CommentIsXml/WasCompiled (distinct 2) get Number fuzzer ints, not restricted to {0,1} — FP risk if a query filters =1 and random ints happen to equal 1, FN if it expects only 0/1.

No FKs declared -> fill_foreign_keys_consistently does nothing; MethodParameter.MethodId and Solution.RepoId get independent random values, so joins Method⋈MethodParameter and Solution⋈Repo produce few/no matches -> FN on join queries.

PK Id columns: INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT — writer inserts explicit values; sample_fresh_primary_keys drops duplicate PK tuples; with distinct<rows in original_values the 5 sampled originals may repeat.
Method.Summary/Lang NULLs (0.13) — String sampler drops None elements (base.py) so fresh draws are non-null; original 5-sample may include NULL, giving some NULLs.

Small tables (Repo 141k, Solution 338k) vs huge (Method 3.5M, MethodParameter 5.1M): choose_table_sizes caps at 2500 or ~230 — generated units are tiny relative to originals, so cardinality-sensitive queries (COUNT, GROUP BY) diverge.
Lang enum (38 values) and Type (13k dotted types) get random strings — ENUM/IN-list queries on these will mostly miss -> FN.
